PockPock Agent 0.2.7 is a new look: **Agent Studio**. Tasks, the Workshop and Settings are redesigned so you can always see what the agent is doing, what it is waiting for, and what to do when something goes wrong.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.6 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.6

### See what the agent is doing
- A **run bar** above every task shows the phase (Understand, Plan, Act, Verify), what is happening now, how long since the agent last sent anything, and the elapsed time. If nothing arrives for 10 seconds it says so and offers **Keep waiting**, **Use a smaller model** or **Stop**.
- **Step 3 of 5**: the agent says which step of the approved plan it is on, and the plan card marks it **Now**. Small models do not always report it; then PockPock shows how many steps finished.
- An **Inspector** on the right shows the model, how much of its context is used, and the files the task read, changed or created.
- A task list with **Needs you** and **Running** groups, and **Ctrl+K** to find any task, page or setting.

### Plans and approvals
- Before you approve a plan, it is checked against the folder and your permission setting (files found, tools allowed, open questions).
- If the plan has a question, answer it with one click and the task is planned again with your answer.
- Edit, reorder, remove or add steps before you approve.
- **Allow for this task**: approve one kind of change once instead of every time.
- Add a note while the agent works; it is given to the agent at its next step.
- A failed task says what was kept, and offers **Retry from step N**, **Open Services** or **Report**.

### Watch pages for changes
- Turn on **Watch for changes** on a saved source, and PockPock re-reads that page every 6 hours while it runs and tells you when it changes. Watching is off unless you turn it on for a page, and only works while **Allow reading public websites** is on. Manage watched pages in **Workshop → Research**.

### Workshop and Settings
- Redesigned Workshop pages: Skills, MCP servers, Connectors, Browser recipes, Research, Local models, Cloud models, Memory, Services, Maintenance and Activity.
- Settings in clear sections, with a theme picker that previews each theme.
- Notifications in the corner for an update that is ready, a stopped gateway, Ollama not running, and a watched page that changed.
- Setup shows where it is: Welcome, Choose, Install, Check.

### Fixes
- "Write a report about the project" is no longer planned as programming work.
- A damaged chat history file no longer hides all your chats.

## Good to know

- Every screen was checked in all four themes (System follows PockPock Dark or Feather), at full size and in a narrow window, with automated accessibility checks.
- Tested live on an RTX 4070 SUPER (12 GB) with `qwen3.5:9b`: plan checks, notes, Allow for this task and step progress. Retry from step N and answering plan questions were tested with simulated agent replies, not a live model.
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
- Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
